name: Fauchard
source: Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 8, Classic Horrors Revisited pg. 8
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 8, Classic Horrors Revisited pg. 8
Statistics
Cost 14 gp Weight 10 lbs.
Damage 1d8 (small), 1d10 (medium); Critical 18-20/x2; Range —; Type S; Special reach,trip
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Exotic
Weapon Groups Polearms
Description
Like a glaive, the fauchard is a curved blade at the end of a pole. However, the cutting edge of a fauchard is along the concave side, like that of a sickle or scythe.
